# Getting help

| You want to… | Go to |
|---|---|
| set the package up in an app | the [README](../README.md): install, peers, CSS and PostCSS setup |
| learn how a component works | [`docs/components/`](../docs/components) and the component's props |
| report something that does not work | an issue with the **Bug** form |
| ask for a change or a new component | an issue with the **Feature** form |
| report missing or wrong docs | an issue with the **Docs** form |
| report a vulnerability | **not** an issue: see [SECURITY.md](SECURITY.md) |

Before you ask, check the README, the [changelog](../CHANGELOG.md) and the open issues. In anything you post, leave out
secrets, tokens, customer data and personal data. The owners are listed in [CODEOWNERS](CODEOWNERS).
